free_text: Biopsy is recommended due to the convergence of high-risk imaging and rising PSA. The PI-RADS 4 lesion in the right peripheral zone mid-gland, coupled with a PSA velocity of 0.35 ng/mL/yr and a recent PSA rise from 3.8 to 4.8 ng/mL, strongly justifies sampling. While the 26% Free PSA is a tempering factor, the high PI-RADS score and PSA trend are decisive factors pushing towards intervention.
